sources.title_short: Teaching a Robot Dog New Tricks
sources.authors: Lemon Foxmere, Elara Whitlock, Nathaniel Reid, Jianhua Sun, Tianyu Li
sources.status: arXiv preprint v1; submitted to IEEE RA-L, no acceptance inferred
sources.key_finding: Multi-teacher PPO plus imitation, imitation-led phase followed by RL-led phase that retains imitation; optional adversarial task allocation; quadruped simulations, not this MOD4 robot.
sources.limits: Paper student uses a different command/observation contract. Borrow retention loss, not its full input or task interface.

sources.title: Scalable Multi-Objective Robot Reinforcement Learning through Gradient Conflict Resolution
sources.key_finding: Per-objective value heads and advantage estimation, prioritized conflict projection; demonstrated in quadruped and humanoid control.
sources.limits: Not proven for this wheel-legged task. New multi-head critic changes training checkpoint schema; official code is based on IsaacLab2.1, not our installed runtime.

sources.title: Adaptive Curriculum of Learning Progress for Reinforcement Learning-Based Legged Locomotion
sources.authors: José David Charry Sánchez et al.
sources.key_finding: Task-conditioned terrain/velocity curriculum driven by learning progress; robust positive progress outperforms several heuristics in its locomotion study.
sources.limits: Increasing samples for negative progress alone can chase oscillations. This is not a universal least-success-rate sampler.

sources.title: Adaptive multi-mode locomotion for bipedal wheel-legged robots via sparse mixture-of-experts deep reinforcement learning
sources.status: Frontiers in Robotics and AI original research; simulation study
sources.key_finding: Two sparse MoE experts specialize in rolling and lifting using learned routing.
sources.limits: Diablo simulation; 12cm stair, 0.6m/s, 153-dimensional observations including three-frame history; not evidence of 20cm at our command speeds or 35-D deployment compatibility.

sources.title: Experience Replay for Continual Learning
sources.key_finding: CLEAR combines on/off-policy learning, replay and behavioral cloning to retain old behavior.
sources.limits: Original algorithm is not PPO. Do not reuse stale trajectories as ordinary on-policy PPO rollouts.

sources.title: Kickstarting Deep Reinforcement Learning
sources.key_finding: Teacher policy guidance is added to reinforcement learning instead of only initial pretraining.
sources.limits: Teacher quality, task validity and annealing must be adapted to the present robot.

sources.title: Proximal Policy Optimization Algorithms
sources.key_finding: Clipped surrogate restricts changes relative to the recent behavior policy; it is not a fixed-ancestor skill-retention guarantee.

sources.title: Benchmarking Massively Parallelized Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning for Robotics Tasks
sources.status: RLC/RLJ 2025 primary paper and author implementation
sources.key_finding: Actor and critic conflicts can differ; critic sharing and value error matter; conflict-avoidance techniques are not uniformly beneficial.
sources.limits: IsaacGym benchmark, not our wheeled robot; report as an implementation and diagnosis caution, not a solution guarantee.
